Provider icons — proposed final state (backlog#158)

One row per provider (128). Each column is what the UI renders after this branch: light theme shows icon.svg; dark theme shows icon_dark.svg when it exists, else icon.svg; icon_monochrome.svg is shown as-is on dark and CSS-inverted on light. Each cell names the file it comes from and whether that file is orig (shipping today, untouched), replaced (existed, discarded and replaced on this branch) or new (there was no such file before). DESIGN = still to be produced in Claude Design; none = no file and none planned.
